I will send the invite today and bring a realistic onboarding plan.","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"Every promise in the email was made in the call: the release note (U038), the file drop email (U081), the invite right after the call (U072), and the realistic onboarding plan (U077).","utterance_ids":["U038","U081","U072","U077"]},{"check":"superseded_feature_as_current","artifact":"recap_email","target":"The warehouse connector now syncs continuously, about a minute end to end, so my hourly comment was wrong.","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"The email states the current continuous sync behavior from RC-12 and explicitly retracts the hourly batch claim from U008.","utterance_ids":["U008","U038","U039"]},{"check":"buying_signal_overstated","artifact":"recap_email","target":"The late load model ran on streaming data, which supports Dana's goal of catching a late load while dispatch can still reroute it instead of finding out the next morning.","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"The line ties the demo to Dana's stated goal in U035 and does not claim a purchase decision or commitment.","utterance_ids":["U035","U080"]}]}
